items.headline: Uniswap Opens $UNI Fee Tool TJAR to Apps, Robinhood First
items.summary: Uniswap Labs opened its TJAR fee-conversion tool to external apps, with Robinhood as the first integration. A fresh DeFi plumbing play for $UNI's ecosystem.

items.headline: 13 Fake $JPMD Tokens Pop Up After JPMorgan Launch
items.summary: A wave of JPMD imitator tokens appeared alongside JPMorgan's Ethereum rollout. Traders should beware of lookalike $JPMD scams riding the news.

items.headline: JPMorgan Brings $MONY Tokenized Fund to Solana
items.summary: JPMorgan is expanding its $MONY and JLTXX tokenized funds onto Solana, pushing institutional RWA deeper into altcoin territory.

items.headline: $POL Extends Bank-to-Stablecoin Stack to Solana
items.summary: Polygon linked Solana wallets to bank funding and payouts after its Tron support and Coinme acquisition. A cross-chain payments push for $POL.

items.headline: $SOL Lands Tokenized Corporate Payment Drafts
items.summary: PrimeRevenue is bringing tokenized corporate payment drafts to Solana, adding a new real-world DeFi use case for $SOL's ecosystem.
